name: Valdecañas de Tajo (Spain)
description: Green field with a white wavy stripe along the lower edge, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Valdecañas de Tajo (reeds on green above waves).
history: Municipal flag of Valdecañas de Tajo; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Valdecañas de Tajo arms — reeds above waves
